title: Lamb Chops With Herb Crust
description: The herb crust enhances the flavor and also keeps the lamb very moist. With the herb flavors and the sealed juices, these cutlets can be ideally served with mash potato to make a fantastic dinner. You can also prepare them in advance for dinner parties.
ingredients: Grapeseed oil (cooks at higher temperature but other vegetable oils are fine)
directions: To a running food processor add your garlic, then the Parmesan cheese. When mixed, add the parsley, the rosemary leaves, thyme, half the lemon peel, the breadcrumbs, and some pepper. Blitz until mixture looks fine, almost like a coarse sand. Empty into plate.
Heat a frying pan using grapeseed oil on high heat. Sear each lamb chop until brown, 1-2 minutes per side, depending on the thickness of the chops. Rest two minutes to let cool down.
With a pastry brush, dip it in the mustard and coat each lamb cutlet all around. Dip coated cutlets in herb mixture, press firmly to ensure it’s coated evenly on all sides.

Melt the butter in the same frying pan and pour over each cutlet. Then, heat the pan and put back the chops in frying pan and place in very hot oven 240°C – 450°F until slightly brown on top, about 10 minutes.
